description: List or search your Android Texter contacts. Each contact has id, phone, name, email, company, notes, tags, and line type and carrier when a lookup has been run. Filter by tag to build a list for send_broadcast.

search.description: Optional. Matches phone, name, email, company, or carrier (case-insensitive substring).

tag.description: Optional. Only contacts carrying this exact tag. See list_contact_tags.

name: list_contacts
title: List contacts
